title: Cloud Security: invoice maturity
content:
Cloud Security uses the following tier-specific bases for invoice maturity.

## Basis

Invoice payment term in calendar days: Calendar days after invoice issue for payment maturity; integer.

Minimum positive monthly invoice amount: Minimum positive monthly invoice total; USD decimal, smaller totals carry forward.

## Tier values

| Security tier | Invoice payment term in calendar days | Minimum positive monthly invoice amount |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Cloud Security 50 Workloads | 30 | 0.5 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 100 Workloads | 30 | 0.5 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 250 Workloads | 30 | 0.5 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 500 Workloads | 30 | 0.5 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 1000 Workloads | 30 | 0.5 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 2500 Workloads | 30 | 0.5 |

## Tier comparison

The listed invoice maturity bases are the same across these six Security tiers.
